title: Neon Hearts
logline: A midnight bike courier who carries secret cargo falls for the comic-book artist who has been drawing her face for months — while a masked collector hunts the pages she just delivered.
grade: Grade: vivid comic-pop palette, saturated primaries, bold inky outlines, halftone shading accents, clean highlights, punchy contrast, slight cel-shaded feel.
cinematic: Cinematic: IMAX-style cinematic scale, large-format digital cinema camera, full-frame sensor look, anamorphic-style widescreen feel adapted to vertical 9:16, smooth gimbal-stabilized camera motion, rich dynamic range, crisp highlight rolloff, premium film-grain finish, realistic physics and motion blur on fast action, no camera shake, no warping, no morphing artifacts.
world: World: a neon-soaked city at night, oversized comic-book architecture, bold graphic shadows, floating motion lines in the air, rain-slick streets reflecting pink and cyan light. One recurring element: a glowing neon heart sign always visible on the skyline.

characters.name: Maya
characters.block: Character: Maya, a 26-year-old bike courier, lean athletic build with a sharp jawline and fierce amber eyes, long black hair in a high ponytail, wearing a red leather jacket over a black hoodie, dark jeans, scuffed combat boots. Distinctive detail: a small lightning-bolt tattoo behind her left ear.

characters.name: Leo
characters.block: Character: Leo, a 24-year-old comic-book artist, lanky build with soft hazel eyes behind round glasses, messy dark-brown hair, wearing a paint-splattered denim jacket over a mustard-yellow t-shirt, a silver ring on his right thumb. Distinctive detail: ink-stained fingers and a crescent-moon tattoo on his wrist.

episodes.title: The First Beat
episodes.hook: A red-jacket courier leans into a rain-slick turn, a masked van inches from her rear wheel.
episodes.cliffhanger: The masked figure pulls a glowing comic page from her bag — it is the exact page Leo has been missing for a year.

scenes.action: Maya's bike leans into a sharp turn, spraying a sheet of water, the masked collector's van clipping a dumpster behind her
scenes.camera: low-angle tracking shot, 24mm wide, speed-ramp on the turn
scenes.context: rain-slick neon street at night, the glowing neon heart sign on the skyline, puddles reflecting pink light
scenes.dialogue: She mutters, breathless, "Not today. Not this package."
scenes.sfx: SFX: tires screeching, water spraying, a metal dumpster crunching. Ambient: rain and distant sirens.

scenes.action: the van doors burst open, two masked figures leap out reaching for the courier bag; Maya swerves between market stalls
scenes.camera: handheld urgency, whip pan across the stalls
scenes.context: open-air night market, canvas awnings, fairy lights, steam rising from food carts, neon heart sign still glowing above
scenes.dialogue: She shouts over the commotion, "Not today!"
scenes.sfx: SFX: screeching tires, canvas tearing, stall wood splintering, shouting. Ambient: market crowd noise.

scenes.action: Maya crashes into Leo's comic stall, scattering prints; Leo catches her by the arm, staring — he recognizes her face from his drawings
scenes.camera: slow-motion 85mm close-up on their eyes meeting, rain dripping off the awning edge
scenes.context: comic stall under a striped awning, warm lamp light, comic prints flying through the air, puddles outside
scenes.dialogue: Leo says, soft and disbelieving, "I know that face. I've been drawing it all month."
scenes.sfx: SFX: paper fluttering, rain on the awning, her breathing. Ambient: distant market music.

scenes.action: one of the masked figures peels back a glowing comic page from her bag; Leo sees his own missing original art and freezes
scenes.camera: extreme close-up on the page, slow push-in, then rack focus to Leo's shocked face
scenes.context: market edge, rain easing, the neon heart sign flickering overhead, the van idling in the background
scenes.dialogue: Leo whispers, frozen, "That's 'The Heart Thief' #1. My pages. My stolen pages."
scenes.sfx: SFX: rain easing, a van engine idling, paper crinkling. Ambient: the heart sign buzzing.

episodes.title: Ink and Asphalt
episodes.hook: A fist pounds the studio door in the middle of the night.
episodes.cliffhanger: The collector raises his mask — it is the gallery owner who launched Leo's show.

scenes.action: Maya paces Leo's tiny studio, rain hammering the skylight; she flips through his sketchbook and finds page after page of her face
scenes.camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, warm lamp light on the pages
scenes.context: cluttered artist studio at night, sketchbooks and ink bottles, fairy lights, the neon heart sign glowing through the window
scenes.dialogue: She says, quiet, "You really have been drawing me. For months."
scenes.sfx: SFX: rain hammering the skylight, pages turning. Ambient: a kettle hissing.

scenes.action: Leo explains the pages were stolen from his gallery debut; Maya realizes her anonymous courier job carried the stolen art
scenes.camera: medium two-shot, subtle dolly-in as the realization lands
scenes.context: same studio, rain continuing, warm lamp light, the sketchbook open between them
scenes.dialogue: He says, low and urgent, "That run tonight? You carried the theft. The collector who hired you stole my show."
scenes.sfx: SFX: rain steady, a chair creaking. Ambient: the kettle clicking off.

scenes.action: a fist pounds the studio door; the collector's men shout through it; Maya grabs Leo's hand and they bolt onto the fire escape
scenes.camera: handheld urgency, low-angle as they burst through the window frame
scenes.context: fire escape in neon rain, wet metal, the heart sign flickering, rain bouncing off the rails
scenes.dialogue: She shouts, "Trust me. I've outrun worse."
scenes.sfx: SFX: pounding fist, glass rattling, boots on wet metal. Ambient: sirens approaching.

scenes.action: on the rooftop the collector corners them and raises his mask — it is the gallery owner who launched Leo's show
scenes.camera: locked-off wide shot, slow push-in on the unmasking
scenes.context: rain-soaked rooftop at night, the neon heart sign behind the collector, steam rising from vents
scenes.dialogue: The collector says, cold and clipped, "The courier was never the target. You were. Those pages are worth more than your show."
scenes.sfx: SFX: rain on metal, a coat rustling, distant sirens. Ambient: the heart sign buzzing behind them.

episodes.title: Neon Hearts
episodes.hook: Black ink explodes across a billboard as two silhouettes sprint across the rooftops.
episodes.cliffhanger: Under the neon heart, a glowing page settles into place — page one of their new story.

scenes.action: Maya and Leo sprint across rain-soaked rooftops, the collector's men in pursuit; Leo lobs a can of black ink that explodes across a billboard, spraying the pursuers
scenes.camera: wide tracking shot, speed-ramp on the ink burst
scenes.context: rain-soaked rooftops, neon signs and billboards, the heart sign glowing ahead, puddles shattering under boots
scenes.dialogue: He laughs, breathless, "Art school, finally paying off!"
scenes.sfx: SFX: ink can clattering, paint splattering across the billboard, boots on wet concrete. Ambient: wind and rain.

scenes.action: Maya rides her bike down a fire escape onto the street and slides under a truck; the collector's van skids and flips in a spray of water
scenes.camera: 180-degree arc around the slide, slow-motion 50% on the flip
scenes.context: neon intersection, rain-glossed asphalt, steam rising from manholes, the heart sign above the intersection
scenes.dialogue: She shouts, triumphant, "That's for my delivery record!"
scenes.sfx: SFX: metal grinding on asphalt, a truck horn, the van flipping, water spraying. Ambient: crowd gasping.

scenes.action: the collector staggers out, mask torn; Leo grabs the stolen pages from his jacket as Maya blocks his exit, police lights swirling in the distance
scenes.camera: locked-off wide, slow push-in on Leo reclaiming the pages
scenes.context: wet street, the neon heart sign flickering above, police strobes washing over the scene, steam curling
scenes.dialogue: Leo says, calm now, "The show opens Friday. You're invited — as the exhibit's cautionary tale."
scenes.sfx: SFX: police sirens, paper crinkling, rain easing. Ambient: the heart sign steadying.

scenes.action: Maya and Leo stand under the neon heart sign, rain easing; he shows her the first page of the new comic — a courier with a lightning-bolt tattoo — and she kisses him as the page glows
scenes.camera: 85mm slow push-in on the kiss, soft halation, shallow depth of field
scenes.context: the glowing neon heart sign above, rain stopping, the wet street reflecting pink light, their silhouettes against the glow
scenes.dialogue: She says, warm and teasing, "Page one of your new issue — I expect royalties."
scenes.sfx: SFX: rain fading to silence, a soft electronic hum from the sign. Ambient: distant city night.
